clue.text: Where junior dinosaur packs roam, Don having fled

definitions.text: Where junior dinosaur packs roam, Don having fled

indicators.note: creatures that roam wander about freely, so the letters wander out of their printed order
someone who has fled is no longer present, so that name's letters are taken out

parts.note: Jr is the standard abbreviation for junior after a name
taken as written
the man's name, taken as written, to be removed

explanation.surface: A description of the place where young dinosaurs run wild in herds once their keeper Don has run off.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove D, O, N from DINOSAUR PACKS, add JR, and rearrange. The whole clue also describes the film's island park, where escaped dinosaurs roam.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spielberg film is set on an island theme park where cloned prehistoric reptiles run loose after the security systems fail.

clue.text: See 1
Fish for a light sleeper

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a smoked, split herring
second meaning: one who takes a kip, a short nap

explanation.walkthrough: A kip is British slang for a short sleep, so someone who kips is a light sleeper.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a smoked herring, and humorously someone who dozes or naps briefly.

clue.text: Applying undue force, learner becomes detached

indicators.note: to become is to turn into something different, so these letters are remade into another word

parts.note: taken as written
g is the symbol for gravitational force, as in g-force
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A learner driver who uses too much force ends up losing touch or falling apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unglued has come unstuck, so it is separated or no longer attached.

clue.text: Former president makes ceremonial marriage vow underground

parts.note: pomp is ceremonial display
the words said at a wedding
U is the abbreviation for underground, as on maps

explanation.surface: A head of state turns a formal wedding promise into an occasion beneath the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Georges Pompidou led France as head of state from 1969 until his death in 1974.

clue.text: Turn out in time for old TV newsreel?

parts.note: News at Ten was the long-running ITV evening bulletin, named for its time slot
the word ends in reel, a lively Scottish dance, while its news half points to the bulletin

explanation.surface: Arriving promptly to watch an old television news film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Newsreel' must be split into news and reel. News at Ten was a British ITV news programme, so its time gives the first part.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnout is the number of people present at an event, which is what this noun counts.

clue.text: Car fever nearly filling container

indicators.note: a filling sits inside something, so one part goes within the other

parts.note: a jar is a container

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: ague is an old word for a malarial fever

explanation.surface: A car's overheating engine almost fills a fuel tank.
explanation.definitionFit: Jaguar is a British manufacturer of luxury motor vehicles, so its name stands for one of its cars.

clue.text: Pooch eating a particle, which makes a change

indicators.note: something eating takes it inside, so one part swallows the other

parts.note: a mutt is a mongrel dog
taken as written
an ion is a charged particle

explanation.surface: A dog swallows a tiny particle and is changed by it.
explanation.definitionFit: A mutation is an alteration, especially in genetic material, so the noun means a change.

clue.text: Expenditure on song that's no longer popular

parts.note: something out has gone out of fashion
a lay is a ballad or song

explanation.surface: Money spent on an unfashionable tune.
explanation.definitionFit: An outlay is the money paid out on something, a synonym for spending.

clue.text: One in Grub Street getting the chop

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a writer of poor-quality work for hire
second meaning: a rough cut or blow

explanation.surface: A struggling writer gets fired.
explanation.walkthrough: Grub Street was a London street of impoverished writers, and its name became shorthand for literary drudgery.
explanation.definitionFit: A jobbing journalist is a Grub Street figure, and the same word means a hacking cut.

clue.text: Giant growth on border of America

parts.note: a polyp is a small growth on tissue
a hem is the edge of cloth
US is the abbreviation for the United States

explanation.surface: A huge tumour has appeared on the edge of the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyphemus is the one-eyed Cyclops blinded by Odysseus in Homer's Odyssey, a mythical giant.

clue.text: Is French woman featured in Scripture?

definitions.text: Is French woman featured in Scripture?

parts.note: est is French for is
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A question whether a Frenchwoman appears in the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: The question reads as the whole definition too: the answer is a woman who features in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Esther is the Jewish queen of Persia whose story is told in her own book of the Old Testament.

clue.text: Recruiting agent, or master of foxhounds?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who finds executives for firms
second meaning, playful: the person in charge of a hunt

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the jokey second reading: the master of foxhounds is literally the chief of the hunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Executive search consultants are called this, and read as two words it means the leading rider on a fox hunt.

clue.text: Inner layer of final lines "To an Empty Room"

parts.note: the end is the final part
an ode is a poem in lines, often titled 'To a' something

indicators.note: an empty thing has lost its contents, so only the outside letters of the word remain

parts.note: only the first and last letters are kept

explanation.surface: The closing lines of a poem titled To an Empty Room.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology the endoderm is the innermost germ layer of an embryo, giving rise to the gut lining.

clue.text: Lacking coherence, fight plenty but lose fast

parts.note: a scrap is a brawl

indicators.note: to lose something is to be without it, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: taken as written
Lent is the Christian season of fasting

explanation.surface: A disorganised boxer throws plenty of punches but loses quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrappy work is disjointed and fragmentary, made of bits that do not hang together.

clue.text: With respect to broken tile in former place of learning

indicators.note: one item placed in another sits inside it

parts.note: a poly was a polytechnic, a type of British college that became a university in 1992

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so its letters are put back together differently

parts.note: rearranged and placed inside

explanation.surface: A note about a cracked tile found in an old college building.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting politely means behaving with courtesy and deference, showing regard for others.

clue.text: Supply seafood in vessel? On the contrary

indicators.note: one item placed in another sits inside it
this flips the roles just stated, so the outer and inner parts swap

parts.note: fish are food from the sea
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: Serving fish in a pot, or perhaps the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the fish goes into the vessel; 'On the contrary' says the vessel goes inside the fish instead.
explanation.definitionFit: To furnish someone with something is to provide or equip them with it.

clue.text: Central European is turning on heartless islander

indicators.note: turning round makes the short word face the other way

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: without a heart means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: in its original sense, a native of the Greek island of Lesbos

explanation.surface: A European is rounding on an island native.
explanation.definitionFit: Silesia is a historical region now mostly in Poland, and a Silesian is someone from there.

clue.text: Curious attire for a ditty

indicators.note: something curious is strange and out of the ordinary, so the letters are oddly arranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Odd clothing for performing a little song.
explanation.definitionFit: An arietta is a short aria, a brief simple tune, so it fits a little song.

clue.text: Composer adds backing part to male solo

parts.note: J. S. Bach, the German composer

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word is read in the other direction

parts.note: a part in a play is a role

explanation.surface: A composer arranges an accompaniment for a man's solo performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solo' means single here, not a musical piece, despite the composer.
explanation.definitionFit: A bachelor is an unmarried man, one living alone rather than as a partner.

clue.text: A second Lincoln brought up as a simple being

parts.note: taken as written
a mo is a moment

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing something up makes it read from the bottom

parts.note: Abe Lincoln, the US president

explanation.surface: Abraham Lincoln is described as having been raised a humble man.
explanation.definitionFit: An amoeba is a single-celled organism, the textbook example of a basic life form.

clue.text: Decide about the Spanish lane

indicators.note: about means around, so one part surrounds the other

parts.note: to rule is to decide judicially
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Choosing between Spanish street names.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruelle is a French word, used in English, for a narrow street or alley.

clue.text: New version in which debauchee swallows measure

indicators.note: whatever swallows something holds it inside

parts.note: a rake is a dissolute man
an em is a printer's unit of measure

explanation.surface: A fresh adaptation in which a libertine downs a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A remake is a film or song produced again, an updated version of an earlier work.

clue.text: Has time in fancy with the flow

indicators.note: one item placed in another sits inside it

parts.note: a fancy is a daydream
to have is to own
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys idle daydreaming and drifts along.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving downstream means travelling in the direction a river's current runs.

clue.text: Deliver blow to party

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a lively social gathering

explanation.surface: Punching someone on the way to a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb for hitting violently and informal slang for a celebration.

clue.text: Radiate support

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to shine or smile broadly
second meaning: a horizontal structural timber

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to shine out light; as a noun it is a load-bearing joist.

clue.text: Fall ill, catching bovine disease, and plummet

indicators.note: to catch something is to hold it inside

parts.note: to ail is to become sick
BSE is mad cow disease

explanation.surface: Cattle sicken, catch a disease and drop dead.
explanation.definitionFit: To abseil is to descend a cliff rapidly on a rope, dropping down a sheer face.

clue.text: Subtract from catering outlet

definitions.meaning: first meaning: remove one number from another
second meaning: a shop selling cooked food to eat elsewhere

explanation.surface: Deducting a sum from what a food shop earns.
explanation.definitionFit: Children say take away for minus, and a British takeaway is a restaurant selling meals to carry home.
